source: NEJM KEYNOTE-868/NRG-GY018 Supplementary Figure S1B pMMR interim OS; deaths assumed from HR CI because arm-level event counts are not printed on the figure
event_count_assumption: Arm-level OS deaths are not printed on Supplementary Figure S1B. Total deaths were approximated from the published pMMR OS HR CI 0.80 (0.59 to 1.08): SE=(log(1.08)-log(0.59))/(2*1.96)=0.154, giving about 168 total events under a balanced-information approximation. A small grid search over arm-level splits selected 88 pembro deaths and 80 placebo deaths because the reconstructed Cox HR was closest to 0.80 while preserving the published NAR table.
